edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His dash + camera swing escape. Engage when it's down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Heroic Swing: 18s at rank 1, 12s at rank 5 — his escape, and Vault's leap-off interrupts it mid-swing. - Avengerang: 9s at rank 1. - Heightened Senses: 50s — spend it to reveal Going Rogue. - Behind Enemy Lines: kill windows only.

notes: Going Rogue is camouflage, not stealth-with-a-detector-immunity, so Heightened Senses' area reveal is a real answer — that matches the mirror audit written from Akshan's side. Nothing was claimed about his revive passive beyond what the existing text already said.
